methodology.grouping: Six framework/row groups; median/mean/min/max are equal-weight statistics over three per-trial values, not pooled request percentiles.
methodology.paired_ratios: Same row count and repeat number. Participants run sequentially in rotated order, not simultaneously; paired ratios do not establish statistical significance.
methodology.resource_denominators: CPU/request recomputed from cumulative whole-container CPU over the resource sampling window divided by validated completions. Quota sample-window percent divides by last minus first sample time and assigned CPUs. Load-duration percent uses load duration instead; resource samples include startup/drain overhead outside that interval.
methodology.phases: Counter wall-time milliseconds divided by completed frontend pages; render includes writer waits and is not pure CPU. Native placeholder counters present as zero in Node are unused instrumentation, not native-cost measurements; .NET missing counters remain absent.
methodology.memory: Maximum sampled whole-container working set, not heap allocation or a leak proof.
methodology.scope: Closed-loop concurrency one, no article, rows1000/5000, frontend1CPU512MiB/backend2CPU1GiB/generator2CPU512MiB; not maximum capacity or an interactive comparison.
methodology.raw_validation: Every retained request ok flag and HTTP status checked; summaries and resource deltas independently recomputed. Response bodies are not retained in raw JSON, so semantic validation is the recorded harness validation, not a second offline body parse.
methodology.bytes: Current Rivet versus .NET measured bodies differ14 bytes. Baseline5000repeat0 uses one-digit trial9 token while current trial10 uses two digits, producing one extra byte in current; other baseline/current matched lengths.

paired_comparisons.direction: Ratios are current/denominator; below one favors current for cost/time/memory, above one favors current for successful RPS.
